summary: This bill establishes the Julius Rosenwald and Rosenwald Schools National Historical Park as a unit of the National Park System to commemorate Julius Rosenwald's philanthropy and the impact of Rosenwald Schools, and creates a National Park Service network to connect and interpret remaining Rosenwald Schools.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a new National Park System unit and authorizes related NPS activities including land acquisition, visitor facilities, cooperative agreements, grants, and a management plan. These provisions create new federal spending obligations without any revenue offsets or deficit-reduction measures, producing a minor expansionary fiscal effect.
